title: shell-tools source component diagram
description: The dispatcher runs each operation on the session's State; read, stat and diff_since load files themselves, while search, list and outline get files, scans and symbols from the daemon through Host.

components.name: Dispatcher (engine.rs)
components.responsibility: Keeps a Sent table per session (64, least recently used dropped) and the Shared memory, parses each request of a call and runs it with the caller's working directory and Host; replies get ok or error.

components.name: Requests (req.rs)
components.responsibility: One strict argument struct per op, selected by `op`; find and ls are aliases of search and list.

components.name: Session memory (state.rs)
components.responsibility: Sent: what a session received per subject (etag, request keys, whole or not) and its refs. Shared: trusted stamps with etags and file versions kept as diff bases (64 MiB). State.serve answers unchanged for a repeated result.

components.name: read (read.rs)
components.responsibility: Capped, ranged reads with if_none_match, unchanged markers and diff replies.

components.name: search (search.rs)
components.responsibility: Compiles the pattern, filters hidden files, asks the Host to scan, then re-reads matched files to render hits, context blocks and the chosen fields.

components.name: list and stat (list.rs)
components.responsibility: Listings from the Host's files and directories with depth, globs, hidden, long rows and cursor paging; stat of one path with an optional content etag.

components.name: outline (outline.rs)
components.responsibility: The Host's symbols per file as [start, end, kind, name], nested names dotted, capped.

components.name: Diffs (diff.rs)
components.responsibility: Line hunks between two versions (similar, 250 ms timeout) and the diff_since operation.

components.name: File access (fsio.rs)
components.responsibility: Stamps (Ident) with the racy rule, whole-file loads with read(2) (O_NOATIME and a sequential hint on Linux), etags and binary sniffing.

components.name: Host (host.rs)
components.responsibility: The interface the daemon implements (files, dirs, search, outline) and the path helpers resolve, display and hidden.

components.name: DaemonHost (daemon)
components.responsibility: The daemon's Host: its walk cache, find's parallel scan (binary and >2 MiB files skipped) and its cached outlines.
